equity.level_reason: Incidence and percent changes are reported by race/ethnicity within birth origin, by birth origin and by age group, and described, but no disparity is framed or quantified as a contrast between groups.

level_alternative.reason: The race/ethnicity results are mainly year-to-year changes within groups, so the SPD results could be read as descriptive strata rather than group comparisons.
